title: Liquibase MongoDB migration fails on Quarkus upgrade from 3.21.4 to 3.26.3 for native test- MongoCommandException: no such command '$db'
body:
### Describe the bug

Liquibase MongoDB migrations fail after upgrading from Quarkus 3.21.4 to 3.26.3. 

In the attached minimal example project, we have two migration steps
```xml
<changeSet id="1" author="RK">
    <ext:createCollection collectionName="persons"/>

    <ext:createIndex collectionName="persons">
        <ext:keys>{personId: 1}</ext:keys>
        <ext:options>{name: "personIdIdx"}</ext:options>
    </ext:createIndex>

    <ext:insertOne collectionName="person">
        <ext:document>{"name":"Jane Doe"}</ext:document>
    </ext:insertOne>
</changeSet>

<changeSet id="2" author="RK">
    <comment>use runCommand to execute arbitrary mongo commands.</comment>
    <ext:runCommand>
        <ext:command>
            {
            update: "persons",
            updates: [
            {
            q: {addresses: null},
            u: {$set: {addresses: []}},
            multi: true
            }
            ]
            }
        </ext:command>
    </ext:runCommand>
</changeSet>
```

When run in the **native** test, the first changeset executes successfully, but the second changeset fails with a MongoCommandException stating "no such command: '$db'". This appears to be a regression in the Liquibase MongoDB extension where the `ext:runCommand` block is not properly parsing MongoDB update commands.

The error occurs specifically in changeset id="2" which contains an `ext:runCommand` with a MongoDB update operation. The same migration works perfectly in Quarkus 3.21.4.

### Expected behavior

Both Liquibase changesets should execute successfully as they do in Quarkus 3.21.4. The `ext:runCommand` should properly execute the MongoDB update command:
```
{
  update: "persons",
  updates: [{
    q: {addresses: null},
    u: {$set: {addresses: []}},
    multi: true
  }]
}
```

### Actual behavior

The application fails to start with the following error:
```
MongoCommandException: Command failed with error 59 (CommandNotFound): 'no such command: '$db'' on server localhost:64091
```

Only the first changeset (id="1") executes successfully. The second changeset (id="2") fails, preventing the application from starting completely.


### How to Reproduce?

Minimal reproduction case available at [demo-quarkus-liquibase.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22275054/demo-quarkus-liquibase.zip).

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
  1. unpack the   provided zip
  2. Run: `./gradlew clean testNative -Dquarkus.native.enabled=true -Dquarkus.native.container-build=false -Dquarkus.package.jar.enabled=false`
 3. check the standard output of the generated `/build/reports/tests/testNative/index.html`


### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

Darwin 24.6.0

### Output of `java -version`

Java 21 (GraalVM Community 21.0.2+13-jvmci-23.1-b30)

### Mandrel or GraalVM version (if different from Java)

_No response_

### Quarkus version or git rev

3.26.3 (Working with 3.21.4)

### Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`)

Gradle 8.10

### Additional information

The issue specifically affects ext:runCommand blocks in Liquibase MongoDB changesets. Standard Liquibase MongoDB operations (ext:createCollection, ext:createIndex, ext:insertOne) work correctly.
